facts.quote: Government of India announces the conversion/switch of its securities through auction for an aggregate amount of ₹20,000 crore (face value).
facts.text: The Reserve Bank of India conducted a conversion and switch auction of Government of India securities for an aggregate notified amount of 20,000 crore INR.

facts.label: official

facts.text: The RBI accepted 2,000.000 crore INR of the short-term source security 8.26% GS 2027 in the switch auction.

facts.label: official
facts.text: The cut-off yield for the ultra-long destination security 7.19% GS 2060 was determined at 7.8391 percent.

facts.label: official

facts.label: official
facts.text: The conversion offer for the 6.03% GS 2029 paper into 7.50% GS 2034 drew zero offers from primary dealers and financial institutions.
